purpose: Small local source compatibility audit, not global validation of every processing baseline
same_safe_product_rule: All four crop grids and every raw DN must match exactly between PC and C1

pb04_pb0510_common_clear_rule.interpretation: Explicit engineering tolerance for this five-pivot pilot. Remaining processing differences must be retained in provenance and discussed as a possible temporal confounder.

pb03_policy: Diagnose native reflectance only; exclude from consolidated dataset because PB04 changed S2B VNIR calibration and no local PB03 versus reprocessed coincidence was available. Do not apply an ad-hoc L2A multiplicative correction.
